title: Egyptian Shrimp Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish from Egypt, made with succulent shrimp and a medley of spices.

ingredients.name: shrimp
ingredients.amount: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and just cooked through, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the rice to the saucepan and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Add the lemon juice and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
